senses.gloss:
n. (-र्य्यं)
A drug, commonly Puṇḍarīya.
E.
अण् added to पुण्डर्य्य.

m. (-ण्ड्रः)
1 A country, extending from Rangpur across the Ganges to the Jangel Mehals and part of south Behar, including therefore the greater part of Bengal.
2 A sort of sugar-cane of a pale straw colour.
E.
पुण्ड्र the same, aff. अण्; also with कन् added पौण्ड्रक.

m. (-कः)
1 The pale straw-coloured species of sugar-cane.
2 A man of a mixed caste, from the Vaiśya and female of the distiller caste, whose business it is to boil sugar.
E.
कन् added to पौण्ड्र.

m. (-नः)
A country, one of the divisions of central India, (Behar.)
E.
पौण्ड्र the sugar-cane, and वर्द्धन encreasing.

m. (-कः)
A pale straw variety of the sugar-cane.
E.
पुण्ड the same, aff. ठञ्.
